meta.aesthetic: Paper and ink with one lit ear tag: a calm, printed product page where tag yellow only ever appears as an object.

concept.statement: One tag: the brand colour is never a background but one big, lit ear tag hanging on the page, and the phone with the real app stands on it where the logo's prompt sits.
concept.mood: Bright daylight on good paper. A livestock ear tag in thick, slightly glossy yellow plastic, lit softly from above, hanging on a graphite knob through its punched hole; knocked once, it swings on the knob and settles. Ink type, set large and tight. Everything else is quiet.
subjectWorld: coding agents on your own machines
a phone in the hand, away from the desk
concept.audienceFeeling: This is a well-made, independent tool that keeps me in touch with my agents; it looks as considered as the app.
avoid: yellow as a background, band, panel or wash (it turns into a warning sign)
the app's status marks (spinner, blue dot, grey ring, red edge) as page decoration
alarm or triage tone ('one needs you', 'they're fine')
tags as wallpaper or repeated pattern
glows, frosted glass or any effect over the app's screen
herdr's ram or any redraw of it
capitalised 'Kudde' in reader-facing copy: the name is written 'kudde'

signature.element: The hanging tag: one A1 ear tag at hero scale, lit like the app icon (gradient, rim light, a punched hole with depth, a soft cast shadow), hanging on a round graphite knob fixed to the page, seen head-on in its punched hole with the hole's top edge resting on it, with the phone standing on its body where the logo's prompt would be.
signature.location: Hero, right half on desktop; below the copy at 375 px. The whole tag stays in view and the hole is never cropped.
signature.implementation: Inline SVG of the A1 path (viewBox 9 4 46 56) sized by a unit var (13.4px desktop, 13px under 1100px, 7.4px under 860px); fill = lit gradient; rim = clipped stroke; hole wall = clipped gradient stroke; CSS drop-shadow. Knob = a separate SVG in the same viewBox that does not turn: a circle of radius 2.4u centred at (32, 11.8), so its top meets the hole's top edge (hole centre (32, 13), radius 3.6); graphite face lit from above (radial #62655e to #2e302c to #121311), an edge running #8a8d85 to #474a44 to #0b0c0a, a faint top highlight, and a small drop-shadow down and to the right onto the tag and through the hole onto the paper. The tag and the phone turn together around the knob's centre (transform-origin 50% 13.93%). No cord. The phone is the HTML rebuild of the app (phone.css), zoom .84 desktop / .64 mobile, placed at 13u-150px x zoom left and 17u below the tag's top, inside the turning tag. Reference: design/site/slice/onetag2.html.
signature.boldnessBudget: Everything else stays quiet: paper ground, ink type, ink buttons, 2px ink rules, no other colour outside the app's screen. One big tag per page; the app icon closes the page.

imagery.direction: The only pictures are the real app on a phone (HTML rebuild or real screenshots with invented names: website, api, docs; workstation, server) and the A1 tag and app icon. No photography, no generated scenes.

layout.composition: Desktop hero: copy left (max 600px), the hanging tag right with its right edge on the 1280px frame. Below the hero, sections on paper separated by 2px ink rules; a 5/7 two-column rhythm for heading versus content. The page ends on the app icon card.
layout.rhythm: Hero min-height max(860px, 100vh - 82px); sections 104-120px vertical padding desktop, 56-72px mobile; 2px ink rule opens each section.

colors._usage: Tag yellow only on the tag, the logo and the app icon; never as a ground and never for text or lines on paper. Text on yellow is ink. Buttons are ink with paper text.

typography._scaleComment: h1 104px desktop, 84px under 1100px, 60px under 860px; implement with clamp(). Bricolage uses opsz 96 at display size.

weightPairing.display: Bricolage Grotesque 800 at -0.04em for the hero and closing statements
weightPairing.emphasis: Bricolage 700 for section heads, Instrument Sans 400 body, 600 for buttons and links

shadows._comment: One light from above, slightly left: every shadow falls down and to the right, warm on yellow, neutral on paper.

animations.choreography: On load the hero tag is knocked once on its knob and swings around the knob's centre, losing about a third each way (0, -9deg, 6.4, -4.4, 3, -1.9, 1.1, -.5, 0 at even steps over 4.8s, 300ms delay; the knock eases out, each later stretch eases in and out like a pendulum), then settles. The phone turns with the tag. Afterwards it leans up to 1.5deg toward a fine pointer. Nothing else moves on its own.
patterns: text links underline on hover, the underline turning tag deep
ink buttons go to pure black on hover

hero.library: CSS keyframes + 15 lines of vanilla JS for the pointer lean
hero.reducedMotionStrategy: show the settled tag; no swing, no lean

accessibility.measured: ink on paper 15.4; muted on paper 6.1; ink on tag yellow 10.0; ink on deep yellow 7.0; yellow on paper 1.5 (decorative only, never text or a lone indicator)

components.header: Paper, 80px (68px mobile), 2px ink rule below; colour A1 mark 34px + 'kudde' in Bricolage 700 28px; links Instrument Sans 500 16px; ink 'Get kudde' button. Under 860px links collapse, the button stays.
components.hero: h1, lede (21px), ink primary button + text link, then the app-icon line (36px icon, mono meta). The hanging tag with the phone on the right.
components.phone: HTML rebuild of the real agent list (phone.css), metal edge, one side key, warm cast shadow on the tag. Invented names only.
components.buttonPrimary: Ink #1c1e1b, paper text, 48px min height, radius 12px, Instrument Sans 600 16px.
components.buttonSecondary: Transparent with a 2px inset ink line.
components.textLink: Instrument Sans 600, 2px underline at 5px offset; hover turns the underline tag deep.
components.stepMarker: 40px A1 outline tag with the step number in Bricolage 800; the current step is filled with tag yellow.
components.rulesList: Two-column list, each item opened by a 2px ink rule, Bricolage 700 22px title, muted body.
components.appCard: Closing block: lit app icon 132px (radius 30px, md shadow), 'kudde' Bricolage 700 40px, one line, ink install button + 'or download the signed APK' link.
components.footer: 2px ink rule; 'Independent app, built on herdr-core. Not made by the herdr project.' and 'Apache-2.0 · Source on GitHub', 14px muted.
